law_name: Copyright Act, 2003 (Act No. 21 of 2003), revised as Chapter 311 (2009 Revised Edition)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 75 years (s. 8(1)); unknown authorship: 50 years from first making available to the public (s. 8(2))
orphan_works: No general orphan-works regime; s. 54 allows certain acts with anonymous works only if the author cannot be identified by reasonable inquiry and copyright has expired or the author died 75+ years earlier
registration_required: No (copyright arises on qualification under s. 6; the Act sets no work registration requirement)
notes: WCT/WPPT status and enforcement body not confirmed; term not verified in statute text
